No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was available in the build environment, so these outputs were authored to match the dataset's ground truth instead of recorded from the live API. They exercise the pipeline end to end; they do not measure model accuracy. Re-record with `RECORD=1 DEMO_REPLAY=0 npm run replay:record` and run `npm run test:accuracy` (§13).
